title: More Cards
description: Custom cards, unlocks, card pool, card genres, related cards, text tables, shiny card rarities and buying many packs at once.

settings.help: Keep saved copies of unavailable custom cards when switching mods or when cards.json fails to load. Off resets those cards as before. Restart the game after changing this option.

settings.title: Most packs per purchase
settings.help: Most booster packs one Card Shop purchase can buy (1 to 9999; 1 = one at a time, as the game does, and the game's own card reveal). In the buy box the single arrows and Left/Right change the count by 1, the double arrows and Up/Down by 10; all the packs open together and the cards are listed once each. Restart after changing it.

settings.title: Shiny cards
settings.help: Real-card rarities: cards pulled from booster packs can come as Rare, Super, Ultra, Secret, Prismatic Secret, Ultimate, Ghost, Gold, Platinum, Collector's, Starlight, Quarter Century Secret, Parallel, Starfoil, Mosaic, Shatterfoil and more (every printed rarity is in Yu-Gi-Oh-Ex\rarities.json's built-in list). They are kept in your save, and the cards are drawn with animated foil, gold or silver names and so on. A card shows the rarest one you own. Off = no rolls and no foil; rarities you pulled stay in the save. Restart after changing it.

settings.title: Shiny odds (%)
settings.help: Percent of every rarity's odds: 100 = as listed (Super 1 in 5 rare-slot cards, Ultra 1 in 12, Secret 1 in 31, Starlight 1 in 576, ...), 50 = twice as many shinies, 200 = half as many. Restart after changing it.

settings.title: Shiny strength
settings.help: How strongly the foil is drawn, 0 to 2. Restart after changing it.

settings.title: Shiny speed
settings.help: How fast the foil moves (1 = normal, 0 = still). Restart after changing it.

settings.title: Shiny follows the mouse
settings.help: On a card shown big (the card details view) the light on the foil follows the mouse pointer, twice as strongly, as if you were tilting the card. Everywhere else, and with this off, it sweeps slowly by itself. Restart after changing it.

settings.title: Shiny preview
settings.help: For trying rarities out: draw EVERY card as this rarity (its key, e.g. starlight, quarter-century-secret, gold, ultimate, ghost, or its name), or cycle = every rarity in turn, 3 seconds each. Empty = off (cards show the rarities you own). Changes nothing in the save. A fixed rarity with its own art (over-rush, full-over-rush, grand-master) also shows the card pictures a mod gives for it; cycle doesn't. Restart after changing it.

settings.title: Frame over full art
settings.help: How much of the frame shows over a full-art card picture (Full Over Rush, Grand Master), 0 = none to 1 = solid, so the name and text stay readable. Broken-frame pictures paint their own frame and never show the game's. Restart after changing it.
